questions.question_text: Sarvādhār je ākāsh chhe te ākāshne _______ kahīe, Chidākāsh kahīe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Pa.46: Sarvādhār je ākāsh chhe te ākāshne Brahma kahīe, Chidākāsh kahīe.

questions.question_text: Je Aksharbrahma chhe te to e Bhagwānne ______ dhām chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Pa.1: Je Aksharbrahma chhe te to e Bhagwānne rahevānu dhām chhe.

questions.question_text: E Akshar bīje rūpe karīne Purushottam Nārāyaņnī _______ rahe chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Pa.21: E Akshar bīje rūpe karīne Purushottam Nārāyaņnī sevāmā rahe chhe.

questions.question_text: Shrījī Mahārāje Sārangpurmā Rāṭhoḍ Dhādhalne gher samaiyo hutāshanīno karyo tyāre pote horī bole ke ‘.... Sadguru khele vasant.’ Em bolī Muktānand Swāmīne ne Ānand Swāmīne kahe ke evā Sadguru koṇ? Tyāre te banne kahe: Evā Sadguru āp. Tyāre Mahārāj kahe: Hamo to sākṣhāt Sadgurunā upāsya Puruṣhottam Bhagavān chhīe. Ne evā Sadguru to ā _______ chhe.
questions.explanation: From Shastriji Maharajno Patra - PRASANG 1: Ne evā Sadguru to ā Guṇātītānand Swāmī mūḷ Akṣhar chhe.

questions.question_text: Ek vakhat Shrījī Mahārāje moṭā moṭā Sadgurunī govāḷ manḍaḷī karī pote vachche rahī pīrsatā hatā. Te vakhat Brahmānand Swāmīne Mahārāj kahe: ‘Ā _______ jame chhe tem jamatā shīkho.’
questions.explanation: From Shastriji Maharajno Patra - PRASANG 2: Brahmānand Swāmīne Mahārāj kahe: ‘Ā Guṇātītānand Swāmī jame chhe tem jamatā shīkho.’

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhaktano paksh dradh karīne rākhyo joïe. Ane te paksh rākhatā thakā ābarū vadho athavā ghato, athavā mān thāo ke apamān thāo, athavā deh jīvo ke maro, pan koi rīte Bhagwān ne _______ mūkavo nahī ne emano abhāv āvavā devo nahī.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.An.7: pan koi rīte Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano pakşh mūkavo nahī ne emano abhāv āvavā devo nahī.

questions.question_text: E Purushottam Bhagwan, Aksharbrahma, māyā, īshvar ane jiv e je _______ bhed te anādi chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Pa.7: E Purushottam Bhagwan, Aksharbrahma, māyā, īshvar ane jiv e je pach bhed te anādi chhe.

questions.question_text: Akṣhar par Puruṣhottam jeh, teṇe dharyu _______ deh.
questions.explanation: From Bhaktachintamani.77/4-7: Akṣhar par Puruṣhottam jeh, teṇe dharyu manuṣhyanu deh.

questions.question_text: Māyā taravano upay e chhe je, jyāre sarva karma ane māyā teno nāsh karanārā ne māyāthī par je sākşhātkār Shri Purushottam Bhagwān athavā te Bhagwānnā maļel _______ temanī jīvne prāpti jyāre thāy chhe tyāre temanā āshraythī māyā ullanghāy chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Je.1: athavā te Bhagwānnā maļel sant temanī jīvne prāpti jyāre thāy chhe tyāre temanā āshraythī māyā ullanghāy chhe.

questions.question_text: Jevo e jīvne potānā sambandhīne vișhe dradh prasang chhe tevo ne tevo ja prasang jo Bhagwānnā _______ vishe thāy to e jīvne mokshanu dvār ughādu thây chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Pa.54: jo Bhagwānnā Ekāntik Sādhune vishe thāy to e jīvne mokshanu dvār ughādu thây chhe.

questions.question_text: E brahma thaki Parabrahma je Purushottam Nārāyan te nokhā chhe ne e brahmanā paņ _______ chhe ne ādhār chhe ne prerak chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Ma.3: e brahmanā paņ kāran chhe ne ādhār chhe ne prerak chhe.

questions.question_text: Jīv īshwar taṇo re, māyā kāḷ puruṣh pradhān; Sahune vash karū̃ re, sahuno _______ hū̃ Bhagavān...
questions.explanation: From Premanand Swami - Oradānā Pad: Sahune vash karū̃ re, sahuno prerak hū̃ Bhagavān...

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnī mūrtinu baļ atishay rākhavu je, 'Sarvoparī ne sadā divya sākārmūrti ane sarva avatārnu avatārī evu je Bhagwānnu swarūp chhe te ja mane prāpt thayu chhe.' Ane je em jāņato hoy ne tethī jo kadāchit satsangthī bāher nīsarī javāņu toy pan tene Bhagwānnī mūrtimāthī _______ țaļatu nathī.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Ma.9: tene Bhagwānnī mūrtimāthī het țaļatu nathī.

questions.question_text: E je ekras tej chhe tene ātmā kahie tathā brahma kahīe ne _______ kahīe; ane e prakāshne vishe je Bhagwānnī mūrti chhe tene ātmānu tattva kahīe tathā Parabrahma kahīe tathā Purushottam kahīe...
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Ma.13: tene ātmā kahie tathā brahma kahīe ne Akshardhām kahīe.

questions.question_text: Jevu paroksh Bhagwānnā Rām-Krushņādik avatārnu māhātmya jāņe chhe tathā Nārad, Sanakādik, Shukjī, Jad-Bharat, Hanuman, Uddhav ityādik je parokșh sādhu tenu jevu māhātmya jāņe chhe tevu ja pratyaksh evā je Bhagwān tathā te Bhagwānnā bhakta sādhu tenu māhātmya samaje tene _______ kāīye samajavu bākī rahyu nahī.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Ma.21: tathā te Bhagwānnā bhakta sādhu tenu māhātmya samaje tene kalyānnā mārgmā kāīye samajavu bākī rahyu nahī.

questions.question_text: Evā santnu darshan thayu tyāre em jāṇavu je, 'Mane _______ darshan thayu.'
questions.explanation: From Vach.Sā.10: 'Mane sākshātkār Bhagwānnu darshan thayu.'

questions.question_text: Evā sant manushya chhe to paṇ _______ sevā karvā yogya chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.An.26: Evā sant manushya chhe to paṇ Bhagwānnī peṭhe sevā karvā yogya chhe.

questions.question_text: Mārī ashṭ prakārnī je pratimā tathā je _______ tene vishe hu akhand nivās karīne rahu chhu.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Ga.Pa.68: Mārī ashṭ prakārnī je pratimā tathā je sant tene vishe hu akhand nivās karīne rahu chhu.

questions.question_text: Satpurushne viṣhe dṛuḍh prīti e ja _______ sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.
questions.explanation: From Vach.Va.11: Satpurushne viṣhe dṛuḍh prīti e ja ātmadarshannu sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.

questions.question_text: Bhakti saras sahu kahe, paṇ bhakti bhaktimā bhed; Bhakti _______, em vade chhe chāre ved.
questions.explanation: From Bhaktinidhi - 9/3: Bhakti Prabhu pragaṭnī, em vade chhe chāre ved.

questions.question_text: Swāminārāyaṇ nāmnā mantra jevo bījo koī mantra āj baḷiyo nathī ne e mantre kāḷā nāgnu paṇ jher na chaḍe ne e mantre _______ ūḍī jāy chhe, brahmarūp thāy chhe ne kāḷ, karma, māyānu bandhan chhūṭī jāy chhe, evo bahu baḷiyo e mantra chhe.
questions.explanation: From Swa. Vato: 1/153: ne e mantre viṣhay ūḍī jāy chhe, brahmarūp thāy chhe ne kāḷ, karma, māyānu bandhan chhūṭī jāy chhe, evo bahu baḷiyo e mantra chhe.

questions.question_text: _______ māṭe āpaṇe vechāvu paḍe to paṇ te ochhu chhe.
questions.explanation: From Shāstrījī Mahārāje prasangopātt uchchārelā chār mahāvākyo: Aksharpurushottam māṭe āpaṇe vechāvu paḍe to paṇ te ochhu chhe.
questions.source_reference: Shāstrījī Mahārāje prasangopātt uchchārelā chār mahāvākyo
